subject.title: feat(ios): unify chat and voice experience

question: Should iOS permanently remove the standalone Talk destination and make Chat the sole entry point for dictation, voice notes, and realtime voice, including rerouting existing `talk` and `voice` launch aliases?
rationale: The code and after-fix proof support the proposed experience, but selecting a permanent navigation contract and accepting its upgrade behavior requires maintainer product ownership rather than an automated patch decision.

options.title: Adopt unified Chat
options.body: Accept Chat as the single conversational destination, preserve the legacy aliases as routes to Chat, and merge after normal iOS owner review.

options.title: Keep Talk as a destination
options.body: Retain a dedicated Talk tab or destination and narrow the branch to shared composer, activity, and ownership work that does not change navigation.

options.title: Defer navigation change
options.body: Pause this PR until an iOS owner defines the supported migration and discoverability contract for existing Talk users.

recommendation.title: Adopt unified Chat
recommendation.body: Accept Chat as the single conversational destination, preserve the legacy aliases as routes to Chat, and merge after normal iOS owner review.

likelyOwner.reason: Prior ClawSweeper routing identified steipete for the unresolved navigation and compatibility decision.
